import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Bitset {
        long[] bits;
        static final int SIZE = 128;
        static final int LONG_SIZE = 64;

        public Bitset() {
            bits = new long[(SIZE + LONG_SIZE - 1) / LONG_SIZE];
        }

        public Bitset(Bitset other) {
            bits = other.bits.clone();
        }

        public void set(int index) {
            int wordIndex = index / LONG_SIZE;
            int bitIndex = index % LONG_SIZE;
            bits[wordIndex] |= 1L << bitIndex;
        }

        public boolean get(int index) {
            int wordIndex = index / LONG_SIZE;
            int bitIndex = index % LONG_SIZE;
            return ((bits[wordIndex] >>> bitIndex) & 1L) != 0;
        }

        public void setAll() {
            Arrays.fill(bits, -1L);
        }

        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Bitset)) return false;
            Bitset other = (Bitset) o;
            return Arrays.equals(bits, other.bits);
        }

        public int hashCode() {
            return Arrays.hashCode(bits);
        }
    }

    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int INV = 570000004;

    static int add_mod(int a, int b) {
        int res = a + b;
        return res >= MOD ? res - MOD : res;
    }

    static int sub_mod(int a, int b) {
        int res = a - b;
        return res < 0 ? res + MOD : res;
    }

    static int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((1L * a * b) % MOD);
    }

    static Map<Bitset, Integer> index_map = new HashMap<>();
    static int node_id = 0, time_idx = 0;
    static int[][] children = new int[65536][128];

    static int dfs(Bitset s) {
        if (index_map.containsKey(s))
            return index_map.get(s);
        int id = time_idx++;
        index_map.put(s, id);
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << node_id); ++mask) {
            Bitset new_s = new Bitset(s);
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << node_id); ++j) {
                if (!new_s.get(j)) {
                    for (int k = mask & j; k != 0; k ^= k & -k) {
                        int pos = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                        if (s.get(j ^ (1 << pos))) {
                            new_s.set(j);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            children[id][mask] = dfs(new_s);
        }
        return id;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());

        // Initialize the DFS
        Bitset initial = new Bitset();
        initial.set(0);
        node_id = 0;
        index_map.clear();
        time_idx = 0;
        dfs(initial);
        node_id = index_map.size();

        int[][] p = new int[n][n];
        int[][] q = new int[n][1 << n];
        int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][node_id];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(line[j]);
                p[i][j] = mul_mod(p[i][j], INV);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                q[i][j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    int val = ((j >> k) & 1) != 0 ? p[k][i] : sub_mod(1, p[k][i]);
                    q[i][j] = mul_mod(q[i][j], val);
                }
            }
        }

        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < node_id; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < (1 << n); k++) {
                    int next_state = children[j][k];
                    dp[i + 1][next_state] = add_mod(dp[i + 1][next_state], mul_mod(dp[i][j], q[i][k]));
                }
            }
        }

        Bitset res = new Bitset();
        res.setAll();
        int resIndex = index_map.get(res);
        System.out.println(dp[n][resIndex]);
    }
}
